description: This file defines a Java class SimpleAudioOutput that provides methods for creating, starting, stopping, and managing an audio output stream using Android's AudioTrack API. It serves as a base class for audio output implementations in Android applications.

classes.name: SimpleAudioOutput
classes.description: A class that encapsulates audio output functionality using Android's AudioTrack, allowing initialization, start, stop, and buffer writing operations for audio playback.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates an AudioTrack with specified frame rate and starts playback.

methods.name: createAudioTrack
methods.description: Configures and returns a new AudioTrack object with parameters based on the frame rate.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a buffer of float audio data into the AudioTrack for playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and releases resources associated with the AudioTrack.

methods.name: getFrameRate
methods.description: Returns the current frame rate used for audio output.
